groups.title: Instruct TTS
groups.subtitle: Voice described in natural language, no reference audio needed

samples.label: Instruct TTS · Mandarin
samples.instruction: Say the following in the voice described here: “一位雄才大略、性格复杂的乱世枭雄，以略显沙哑却极有穿透力的中年男声说话。语气自信、果断，带着审视人心的敏锐感。讲话时节奏变化明显，可以先压低声音缓缓铺垫，再突然加重关键字。既有豪迈，也隐约带着危险与猜疑”
samples.voice_description: 一位雄才大略、性格复杂的乱世枭雄，以略显沙哑却极有穿透力的中年男声说话。语气自信、果断，带着审视人心的敏锐感。讲话时节奏变化明显，可以先压低声音缓缓铺垫，再突然加重关键字。既有豪迈，也隐约带着危险与猜疑
samples.spoken_text: 宁可我负天下人，休教天下人负我。

samples.label: Instruct TTS · Mandarin
samples.instruction: Say the following in the voice described here: “一位中年女性，在面对面质问多年前抛弃自己的人时，用沙哑、干涩的嗓音倾诉三十年压抑的恨意与委屈，仿佛眼泪已经流尽。语速缓慢而沉稳，字字清晰冰冷，整体音量中等偏低，但说到愤恨处声音微微发颤、压抑着哽咽，音色苍凉而有力，句尾带着渗骨的决绝，最后一句陡然拔高、几乎用尽全身力气砸出来”
samples.voice_description: 一位中年女性，在面对面质问多年前抛弃自己的人时，用沙哑、干涩的嗓音倾诉三十年压抑的恨意与委屈，仿佛眼泪已经流尽。语速缓慢而沉稳，字字清晰冰冷，整体音量中等偏低，但说到愤恨处声音微微发颤、压抑着哽咽，音色苍凉而有力，句尾带着渗骨的决绝，最后一句陡然拔高、几乎用尽全身力气砸出来
samples.spoken_text: 哼，我的眼泪早哭干了，我没有委屈，我有的是恨，是悔，是三十年一天一天我自己受的苦。你大概已经忘了你做的事了！

samples.label: Instruct TTS · English
samples.instruction: Say the following in the voice described here: “A classic Shakespearean villain savoring the moment just before unveiling the truth. A rich, theatrically charged baritone with full chest resonance; unhurried pacing with deliberate pauses and emphases; consonants rolled with exaggeration, diction crisp and staged. The tone feigns sweetness, almost doting, then snaps cold between the words — sharp as a blade, every syllable laced with dangerous, delighted smugness”
samples.voice_description: A classic Shakespearean villain savoring the moment just before unveiling the truth. A rich, theatrically charged baritone with full chest resonance; unhurried pacing with deliberate pauses and emphases; consonants rolled with exaggeration, diction crisp and staged. The tone feigns sweetness, almost doting, then snaps cold between the words — sharp as a blade, every syllable laced with dangerous, delighted smugness
samples.spoken_text: You see, my dear, the trap was never meant for you. It was always meant for him.

samples.label: Instruct TTS · English
samples.instruction: Say the following in the voice described here: “As if delivering devastating news at a funeral — a soft, choked voice forcing back tears, speech breaking between pauses, each word heavier than the last, the final line torn open by grief, trembling with a sob that can no longer be held down. Slow, low intonation with unsteady breath; clarity slightly eroded by the choking. The overall mood is solemn and mournful”

samples.label: Content Editing · Mandarin
samples.spoken_text: 愚夫，久闻先生大名如雷贯耳，曾两次进谒不得相见，已留书一封，不知可曾阅过？南阳野人，疏懒成性，吕蒙将军枉临，不胜惭愧。将军，请。先生请。二弟、三弟在此等候。

add.text: 在下辗转反侧，梦寐以求

nvInstructions.➕ Add: Add “在下辗转反侧，梦寐以求” after “不得相见”
nvInstructions.🔁 Replace: Replace “曾两次进谒不得相见” with “我想与先生共商国事”

samples.label: Content Editing · Mandarin
samples.spoken_text: 等仗打完了，我赏给你半斤地瓜烧。啊，不过你得好好琢磨琢磨，怎么用两发炮弹，把敌人的指挥部给我打掉了。

nvInstructions.➕ Add: Add “三座大别墅” after “半斤地瓜烧”
nvInstructions.🔁 Replace: Replace “半斤地瓜烧” with “两只大烧鸡”

samples.label: Content Editing · English
samples.spoken_text: You know, thank you guys for all your sacrifice. You know, for all the hours I spend in the gym working and training, and Vanessa, you holding down the family the way that you have, I can't. There's no way I can thank you enough for that. So from the bottom of my heart, thank you. And what can I say? Mamba out.

delete: You know, for all the hours I spend in the gym working and training
